sender.en: A “recruiter” or “receptionist” on Telegram, Messenger or WhatsApp

name.en: Task job scam: liking pages for commission, then a deposit to “upgrade” to VIP

how.en: Someone offers easy online work: liking shop pages, hotel listings or videos for P20 to P150 a task, with no upfront payment. A Telegram bot really pays the first small amounts. Then you are told to pay to reach a “VIP level”, unlock “welfare tasks” or move money into a crypto account to earn more. Each step needs a bigger deposit, and in the end you cannot withdraw anything.

text.en: A stranger offers easy online tasks with daily pay.
You are moved to a Telegram group or bot with a “receptionist” or “mentor”.
Small first payments arrive to win your trust.
You must pay or deposit to upgrade, unlock tasks or withdraw.
The deposits keep growing and you are pushed to finish quickly.

Hi! We are hiring part-time online assistants. Just like and follow shop pages using your phone, P150 per task, up to P3,000 a day, paid same day to GCash. No fee needed! Message our receptionist on Telegram to start: [link]

en: liking pages on telegram for commission then asked to deposit
online task job asked me to upgrade to vip
telegram bot sent a small commission then wanted a deposit
like and follow job that needs a recharge
welfare task bonus asked for payment
job asked me to open a crypto wallet and deposit
Pay for very simple online tasks.
Having to pay or deposit to earn or withdraw.
Recruiters who only use Telegram, WhatsApp or Messenger.
Stop. A real job never asks you to pay to work or to withdraw your earnings.
Don’t send more money to “unlock” what you already paid.
If you sent money, call your bank or e-wallet straight away and report it to the PNP-ACG or CICC 1326.
